check.language_note: The recorded it query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: IT-search = searches 1, 2 (en, it). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: Article 20 allocates AI Act notifying and market-surveillance roles to AgID and ACN; these regulatory functions do not establish a qualifying institute.

claims.text: The legislative decree makes it a national market-surveillance authority under the AI Regulation, as the competent authority for high-risk AI systems used in providing loans or other financial services governed by the consolidated banking law.

The legislative decree makes it a national market-surveillance authority under the AI Regulation, as the competent authority for high-risk AI systems used in providing financial services governed by the consolidated law on financial intermediation.

The legislative decree makes it a national market-surveillance authority under the AI Regulation, as the competent authority for high-risk AI systems used in insurance or reinsurance business and in distributing insurance products governed by the Private Insurance Code.
The legislative decree makes it a national market-surveillance authority under the AI Regulation, limited to what Article 74(8) of that regulation provides.

record.summary: No qualifying institute identified as of October 2026. National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN) is its AI Act single point of contact and market-surveillance authority; five other AI Act bodies are listed below.
